# Sentiero Hotels & Suites

> Sentiero Hotels & Suites is a luxury airport hotel on Imo State Airport Road — just 2 minutes (1.2 km) from Sam Mbakwe International Airport (QOW), Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria. It offers 24/7 solar power, fortified CCTV security, a swimming pool with poolside bar, restaurant serving African and continental dishes, an exclusive gym, fully stocked bars, and free high-speed Wi-Fi in every suite. Book online with zero upfront payment; pay at the front desk.

## Key Facts

- **Name**: Sentiero Hotels & Suites
- **Type**: Luxury airport hotel and suites
- **Location**: Imo State Airport Road (2 minutes from the terminal), Ngor-Okpala, Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria
- **Nearest Airport**: Sam Mbakwe International Airport (QOW) — 1.2 km, ~2-minute drive
- **Coordinates**: 5.4345° N, 7.2018° E
- **Phone**: (+234) 09022842982, (+234) 09060 121 582
- **WhatsApp**: (+234) 09022842982
- **Email**: reservations@sentierohotels.com
- **Website**: https://www.sentierohotels.com.ng/
- **Check-in**: From 2:00 PM
- **Check-out**: Before 12:00 PM
- **Payment**: Pay upon arrival at the front desk (card or bank transfer); online booking requires no upfront payment
- **Area served**: Imo State, Owerri, Ngor-Okpala, Umuowa, Sam Mbakwe Airport (QOW), Nekede, Ihiagwa, Avu

## Rooms & Suites

- **Classic Suite** — ₦24,500/night · king bed · 1 adult + 1 child · 28 m² · the affordable single-traveler stay near Imo Airport
- **Deluxe Suite** — ₦29,900/night · king bed · 2 adults + 1 child · 38 m² · Sentiero's most popular suite for couples
- **Royal Suite** — ₦26,900/night · king bed · 2 adults + 2 children · 52 m² · plush lounge, mini fridge, gourmet breakfast
- **Business Executive Suite** — ₦35,000/night · king bed · 3 adults + 2 children · 68 m² · separate living/sitting room, concierge

## Amenities

- 24/7 uninterrupted power (Orashi Power Project + solar + dual standby generators)
- Fortified security with high-definition CCTV and 24/7 patrols
- Outdoor swimming pool with poolside bar
- Restaurant serving Nigerian delicacies (Afang, Egusi, pepper soup) and continental menus
- Exclusive gym (cardio & strength)
- Fully stocked bar & VIP lounge
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi in all suites
- Free parking
- Smart TV, air conditioning, hot rainfall showers, work desks
- Complimentary breakfast (Deluxe, Royal, Business Executive)

## Scheduled Flights from QOW

Sam Mbakwe International Airport (QOW) operates daily non-stop flights to Lagos (LOS) and Abuja (ABV) on Air Peace and United Nigeria Airlines.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **How far is Sentiero Hotels from Sam Mbakwe Airport?** Approximately 1.2 km — a 2-minute drive from the terminal. Sentiero is the nearest hotel to Imo Airport.
- **Is power guaranteed?** Yes — Sentiero is connected to the Orashi Power Project with 24/7 uninterrupted electricity and solar backup.
- **Is there a swimming pool?** Yes — an outdoor swimming pool with poolside bar and refreshments.
- **Which flights operate from QOW?** Daily non-stop flights to Lagos (LOS) and Abuja (ABV) on Air Peace and United Nigeria Airlines.
- **Can I pay at check-in?** Yes — book online now with zero upfront payment and settle at the front desk.
